items.name: ExprPlanner
items.summary: Customize planning of SQL AST expressions to [`Expr`]s

methods.name: plan_aggregate
methods.summary: Plans aggregate functions, such as `COUNT(<expr>)`

methods.name: plan_array_literal
methods.summary: Plan an array literal, such as `[1, 2, 3]`

methods.name: plan_binary_op
methods.summary: Plan the binary operation between two expressions, returns original BinaryExpr if not possible

methods.name: plan_compound_identifier
methods.summary: Plans compound identifier such as `db.schema.table` for non-empty nested names

methods.name: plan_dictionary_literal
methods.summary: Plan a dictionary literal, such as `{ key: value, ...}`

methods.name: plan_extract
methods.summary: Plan an extract expression, such as`EXTRACT(month FROM foo)`

methods.name: plan_field_access
methods.summary: Plan the field access expression, such as `foo.bar`

methods.name: plan_make_map
methods.summary: Plans a `make_map` expression, such as `make_map(key1, value1, key2, value2, ...)`

methods.name: plan_overlay
methods.summary: Plans an overlay expression, such as `overlay(str PLACING substr FROM pos [FOR count])`

methods.name: plan_position
methods.summary: Plan a `POSITION` expression, such as `POSITION(<expr> in <expr>)`

methods.name: plan_struct_literal
methods.signature: fn plan_struct_literal(&self, args: Vec<Expr>, _is_named_struct: bool) -> Result<PlannerResult<Vec<Expr>>>
methods.summary: Plans a struct literal, such as  `{'field1' : expr1, 'field2' : expr2, ...}`

methods.name: plan_substring
methods.summary: Plan an substring expression, such as `SUBSTRING(<expr> [FROM <expr>] [FOR <expr>])`

methods.name: plan_window
methods.summary: Plans window functions, such as `COUNT(<expr>)`

items.name: RelationPlanner
items.summary: Customize planning SQL table factors to [`LogicalPlan`]s. For more background, please also see the [Extending SQL in DataFusion: from ->> to TABLESAMPLE blog]

methods.name: plan_relation
methods.signature: fn plan_relation(&self, relation: TableFactor, context: &mut dyn RelationPlannerContext) -> Result<RelationPlanning>
methods.summary: Plan a table factor into a [`LogicalPlan`].

items.name: RelationPlannerContext
items.summary: Provides utilities for relation planners to interact with DataFusion's SQL planner.

methods.name: context_provider
methods.summary: Provides access to the underlying context provider for reading session configuration, accessing tables, functions, and other metadata.

methods.name: normalize_ident
methods.summary: Normalizes an identifier according to session settings.

methods.name: object_name_to_table_reference
methods.summary: Normalizes a SQL object name into a [`TableReference`].

methods.name: plan
methods.signature: fn plan(&mut self, relation: TableFactor) -> Result<LogicalPlan>
methods.summary: Plans the specified relation through the full planner pipeline, starting from the first registered relation planner.

methods.name: sql_expr_to_logical_expr
methods.signature: fn sql_expr_to_logical_expr(&mut self, expr: SQLExpr, schema: &DFSchema) -> Result<Expr>
methods.summary: Converts a SQL expression into a logical expression without DataFusion rewrites.

methods.name: sql_to_expr
methods.signature: fn sql_to_expr(&mut self, expr: SQLExpr, schema: &DFSchema) -> Result<Expr>
methods.summary: Converts a SQL expression into a logical expression using the current planner context.
